verdict.rationale: Swell documents a Liquid-based templating layer with Shopify-compatible tags/objects and a visual theme editor (swell-docs-10), theme apps like Proxima supporting duplication/distribution and the Theme Editor (swell-docs-13, swell-docs-40), and an official CLI (swell app init, switching stores) confirmed to actually install and run (swell-probe-3, swell-probe-rt-1). This covers documented templating, local dev workflow, and CLI-based deploy tooling for version-controlled theme management. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of local hot-reload preview server and explicit git-based version control workflow for themes.
